title: 安全常识测验：事故成本与安全色

author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/17_Safety Objective Type Q A Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Safety MCQ/src.py

points.K1: 安全管理：减少、控制、消除危害

shots.scene: 欣欣举着写有15的牌子，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank sign with a large number-shaped badge and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天十五道安全常识题，一起来答。

shots.scene: 一行图标：盾牌、钱袋、标志牌、心形
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a shield, a money bag, a safety sign and a heart. No people.
shots.narration: 管理、成本、标志、态度，一个不落。

shots.scene: 王老师带着阿杰和小研在走廊巡查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads the young male student and the female graduate student on an inspection walk in a corridor.
shots.narration: 王老师带新同事巡查。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着各色标志
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at colorful safety signs on the wall.
shots.narration: 边走边问，十五道题边看边答。

shots.section_title: 安全管理：减少、控制、消除危害
shots.scene: 危险图标依次变小、被框住、消失
shots.prompt_en: A hazard icon shrinks, then is boxed in, then disappears. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：安全管理管什么？
overlay: 安全管理：减少、控制、消除危害

shots.section_title: 安全管理：减少、控制、消除危害
shots.scene: 欣欣举起三个勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with three check marks.
shots.narration: 减少、控制、消除危害，答案D。

shots.scene: 冰山图标，水下部分很大
shots.prompt_en: An iceberg icon with a small tip above water and a huge part below. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：哪些是事故的间接成本？

shots.scene: 水下部分出现时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: Below the water a clock icon with lost hours lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，受伤人员损失工时的成本。

shots.scene: 冰山露出水面的部分：药箱和钱袋
shots.prompt_en: The tip of the iceberg shows a first aid kit and a money bag. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：直接成本呢？

shots.scene: 欣欣指着冰山顶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the tip of the iceberg.
shots.narration: 答案D，医疗费和赔偿金。

shots.scene: 检查表四格：工作区、材料、机器、工具
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with four boxes showing icons of a work area, materials, a machine and tools. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：危害分析检查表查什么？

shots.scene: 四格一起打勾，人形图标那张卡打叉
shots.prompt_en: The four checklist boxes get green checks, while an option card with a person icon is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，工作区域、材料、机器、工具。

shots.scene: 标志牌、彩色条纹、喇叭三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sign board, colored stripes and a loudspeaker. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：安全信息用什么表达？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 标志牌、颜色、声信号，答案D都是。

shots.scene: 三类标志排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Three kinds of safety signs in a row: prohibition and warning, emergency and first aid, and mandatory. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：安全标志牌有哪几种？

shots.scene: 三类标志一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three kinds of signs get green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都是。

shots.scene: 红圈斜杠的禁止标志：禁止烟火
shots.prompt_en: A red circular no-smoking prohibition sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：禁止和危险用什么色？

shots.scene: 红色禁止标志和红色报警器
shots.prompt_en: A red prohibition sign and a red danger alarm beacon. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，红色：禁止和危险报警。

shots.scene: 黄色三角警告标志：当心腐蚀
shots.prompt_en: A yellow triangular corrosive warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：警告用什么色？

shots.scene: 阿杰在黄色标志前放慢脚步
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slows down in front of a yellow warning sign.
shots.narration: 答案B，警告用黄色，也叫琥珀色。

shots.scene: 蓝色圆形指令标志：必须戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: A blue circular mandatory sign for eye protection. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：指令用什么色？

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles under the blue sign.
shots.narration: 答案C，指令用蓝色。

shots.scene: 绿色紧急出口和急救标志
shots.prompt_en: Green emergency exit and first aid signs. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：疏散和急救用什么色？

shots.scene: 小研指着绿色箭头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points along a green exit arrow.
shots.narration: 答案D，疏散和急救用绿色。

shots.scene: 辐射标志旁四张颜色卡：红、橙、绿、紫
shots.prompt_en: A radiation hazard symbol beside four color cards: red, orange, green and purple. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：辐射危害用什么颜色？

shots.scene: 紫色卡片亮起打勾
shots.prompt_en: The purple color card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，紫色。

shots.scene: 三个图标：管理者、员工、工作环境
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a manager figure, a worker figure and a workplace building. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：事故谁有责任？

shots.scene: 三个图标连成三角
shots.prompt_en: The three icons connect into a triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 管理者、员工、环境条件，答案D。

shots.scene: 防护用品、安全员、警示牌三张卡片淡出
shots.prompt_en: Cards of protective gear, a safety officer badge and a warning sign fade out. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：什么能让你始终安全？

shots.scene: 阿杰头顶亮起一颗心和一只眼睛
shots.prompt_en: A heart and an eye icon glow above the young male student's head.
shots.narration: 答案D，自己的注意力和安全态度。

shots.scene: 走廊冒烟，小研往出口走
shots.prompt_en: Smoke drifts in a corridor and the female graduate student walks toward the exit.
shots.narration: 第十四题：火灾时首先关注什么？

shots.scene: 自身安全的卡片亮起，同事和财产卡片淡出
shots.prompt_en: A card with a person and a shield lights up, while cards for coworkers and company property fade. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，自身安全，不是同事或财产。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着镜子调整护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks his safety goggles in a mirror.
shots.narration: 第十五题：谁确保你戴对防护用品？

shots.scene: 同事、安全部门、企业主卡片淡出，阿杰亮起
shots.prompt_en: Cards for a coworker, a safety department and a business owner fade, while the young male student is highlighted.
shots.narration: 答案A，你自己，不是同事或老板。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在标志墙前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a wall of colored safety signs.
shots.narration: 红禁止、黄警告、蓝指令、绿急救。

shots.scene: 紫色卡片和辐射标志
shots.prompt_en: A purple color card beside a radiation hazard symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 原题：辐射危害用紫色。

shots.scene: 冰山图标
shots.prompt_en: The iceberg icon again. No people.
shots.narration: 间接成本是损失工时，直接是医药赔偿。

shots.scene: 心形和护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon and a pair of goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 安全靠态度，火灾先保自己，防护自己戴。

shots.scene: 欣欣和三人在走廊挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the safety administrator and two colleagues in the corridor.
shots.narration: 十五问到这里，下次见！
